cupcake.prep: Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners.
cupcake.cook: Fill each liner about 2/3 full with batter. Bake at {temp} for {time}, until the tops spring back when lightly pressed.
cupcake.check: A toothpick inserted into the center of a cupcake should come out clean.
notes: Let the cupcakes cool completely before frosting, or the frosting will melt.
Rotate the tin halfway through if your oven has hot spots.

cupcake.prep: Set air-fryer-safe silicone or foil cupcake cups in the basket, leaving space around each one.
cupcake.cook: Fill each cup about 2/3 full. Air fry at {temp} for {time}, until risen and golden.
cupcake.check: A toothpick inserted into the center of a cupcake should come out clean. If the tops brown too fast, cover loosely with foil.
notes: Air fryers vary a lot - start checking at the early end of the range.
Weigh down loose paper liners so they cannot lift toward the heating element.

cupcake.prep: Set heat-safe silicone or foil cups in a steamer basket, leaving space between them. Wrap the lid in a clean kitchen towel to catch drips.
cupcake.cook: Fill each cup about 2/3 full. Cover and steam at a steady medium steam for {time}. Do not lift the lid during the first 10 minutes.
cupcake.check: A toothpick inserted into the center of a cupcake should come out clean. Steamed cupcakes stay pale and extra soft.
notes: Steamed cupcakes do not brown - that is normal.
Keep the water at a steady simmer and top it up with hot water if needed.

recipes.name: Vanilla Cupcakes
recipes.description: Light, tender cupcakes with a soft vanilla crumb - perfect for frosting.

yield.note: Based on a standard 12-cup muffin tin.

less.note: Sugar helps give cupcakes their soft, tender crumb, so the reduction for this recipe is about 20%.
expectedChanges: Crumb may be slightly less tender and moist

steps.title: Cream {L|^butter|Butter;^granulated_sugar|Sugar}
steps.text: In a large bowl, beat the {L|@butter|softened butter;#granulated_sugar|sugar} until pale and fluffy, about 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add {L|^egg|Eggs;^vanilla_extract|Vanilla}
steps.text: Beat in the {#egg|eggs} one at a time{?vanilla_extract|, then the |vanilla|}, scraping down the bowl.

steps.title: Mix Dry Ingredients
steps.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the {L|=flour;#baking_powder|baking powder;=salt}.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add the dry ingredients to the {#butter|butter} mixture in two or three additions, alternating with the {#milk|milk}. Mix until just smooth.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool the cupcakes in the tin for 5 minutes, then move them to a wire rack to cool completely before frosting.

tips: @butter,milk,egg: Room-temperature butter, eggs and milk blend into a smoother batter.
@heavy_cream: Use an ice cream scoop for evenly sized cupcakes.
Frost only when the cupcakes are completely cool.

recipes.description: Moist, rich cupcakes with deep cocoa flavor.

yield.note: Based on a standard 12-cup muffin tin.

less.note: Cocoa is bitter, so these keep most of their sugar - about 20% less is the safe limit.
expectedChanges: Chocolate flavor tastes a little more intense
Crumb may be slightly less tender

steps.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the {L|=flour;#cocoa_powder|cocoa powder;#baking_powder|baking powder;#baking_soda|baking soda;=salt}.

recipes.name: Strawberry Cupcakes
recipes.description: Pink-flecked cupcakes with real strawberry pieces.

yield.note: Based on a standard 12-cup muffin tin.

less.note: The strawberries add natural sweetness and juiciness, so about 20% less sugar still tastes sweet.
expectedChanges: Crumb may be slightly less tender

steps.title: Cream {L|^butter|Butter;^granulated_sugar|Sugar}
steps.text: In a large bowl, beat the {L|@butter|softened butter;#granulated_sugar|sugar} until pale and fluffy, about 3 minutes.

steps.text: Beat in the {#egg|eggs} one at a time{?vanilla_extract|, then the |vanilla|}, scraping down the bowl.

steps.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the {L|=flour;#baking_powder|baking powder;=salt}.

steps.text: Add the dry ingredients to the {#butter|butter} mixture in two or three additions, alternating with the {#milk|milk}. Mix until just smooth.

steps.text: Cool the cupcakes in the tin for 5 minutes, then move them to a wire rack to cool completely before frosting.

recipes.name: Banana Cupcakes
recipes.description: Soft, naturally sweet cupcakes made with ripe bananas.

yield.note: Based on a standard 12-cup muffin tin.

less.note: Ripe bananas provide lots of sweetness, so about 25% less sugar works well.
expectedChanges: Crumb stays moist thanks to the banana

steps.title: Cream {L|^butter|Butter;^granulated_sugar|Sugar}
steps.text: In a large bowl, beat the {L|@butter|softened butter;#granulated_sugar|sugar} until pale and fluffy, about 3 minutes.

steps.text: Cool the cupcakes in the tin for 5 minutes, then move them to a wire rack to cool completely before frosting.

These cupcakes are tender - let them cool in the tin for 5 minutes before moving.
